title: Explainable XGBoost on metabolomics separates atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease cases
summary: In 63 patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and 52 matched controls from FLEMENGHO, PLS-DA selected 56 metabolites and an XGBoost model reached test AUC 0.75; the selected metabolites reached AUC 0.93 in an independent external cohort. SHAP ranked cholesterol and 3-methylhistidine among the top contributors. The cohort is small and cross-sectional.
ai_technology: PLS-DA dimension reduction followed by XGBoost with SHAP on plasma metabolites

evidence.tested: Evaluation of the selected metabolites in an independent external cohort.
evidence.unknown: The external cohort size and causal links are not established here; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classified ASCVD status and ranked metabolites.
